description: Land Title Settlement Department - Karuwalabadda, Gonapeenuwala D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, and owners) in a defined geographical area. The content focuses entirely on land ownership determinations, property registrations, and land title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
